items.summary: Create a detailed real-time metrics display component that shows exact tab switching data including precise switch timestamps (with milliseconds), switch frequency (per minute and per hour), time away durations for each switch, current distraction score with calculation breakdown, and total switches count since session start

Update LiveMonitor component in frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx to include a dedicated 'Validation Metrics' section that displays the detailed real-time metrics component with all precise switching data visible simultaneously for system accuracy verification

Enhance useFocusMonitor hook in frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts to expose a detailed switching history array containing the last 20 switch events with exact timestamps, away duration, and distraction score at time of switch for debugging and validation purposes
